text: In Adelaide, seventeen-year-old Mia, [still raw on the anniversary of her mother's death|wrong|loss that won't heal], joins a party game built around [an embalmed severed hand|images|corpses and body parts]. Grip it and say talk to me, and a dead stranger appears; say [I let you in|rules|it must be let in] and it takes your body, but someone must pull the hand away and blow out the candle [within ninety seconds|rules|death on a deadline]. When Jade's little brother Riley takes a turn, the voice coming through him sounds like Mia's mother, and Mia [cannot bear to let her go|who_suffers|the grieving].
